32.question: The Clifford Constitution
options: made the Governor dependent on the Executive Council
provided for an unofficial majority membership of the Legislative Council
provided for African representation on the Executive Council
introduced the elective principle into Nigerian politics
32.explanation: The Clifford Constitution introduced elected representation on a limited franchise, with seats for Lagos and Calabar. This was the elective principle; it did not establish universal adult suffrage.
